title: Bound the original n18 ABCD family by joint raw-price and compiler funding
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This scoped negative result rules out simultaneous necessary raw and tail
funding for every nonnegative real signed-ABCD paid profile at exactly
`.0033` and `.0033000005`, with the original PR5580 n18 caller and retained
cutoff17/floor18/offset1/5/decay.97. The domain fixes rank mass5915 and tag
mass3458 on ranks1..6, with tag6=2, p7=14, source helpers and every nonlocal
coefficient unchanged. It includes signed reverse exchanges and arbitrary
real pooling. No construction, new kappa, all-n or changed-route ceiling is claimed.

A rational Farkas separator covers the whole invariant plane. Raw feasibility
requires local tail increase greater than228.3675/228.3681, while an independent
source-moment recount and explicit source-to-goal transport put available
headroom below140.0588/140.0589. All exact fractions and all six coefficient
slacks are retained. Source gamma(C0)>.965 is independently established;
the author quote is not accepted as its proof.

## Task and overlap

source: `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a` ([PR5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580)).

([PR5577](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5577)). A whole
raw-profitable witness failing gamma would leave partial mixtures open;
the invariant-plane dual closes that gap in this precise retained scope.

The newer [PR5565](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5565)
commuting-contact cascade at exact head
`9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95` claims conditional
kappa `.00308520`, tested `.0030852005`, with 66,726 paid jobs and 12,814
productive fields. Its Stage A commutes four ADDs into the zero-dimensional
chart; Stage B changes the scalar chronology and helper531 from H8 to H9.
Those changes leave this original5580 fixed-helper invariant domain, so the
obstruction does not transfer automatically. See its pinned
[claim](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/CLAIM.md),

The authenticated 21:24:19 UTC curator checkpoint records its hosted run
40234415339 as in progress. This is an author conditional claim, not selected
or independently admitted. The frozen exact-source obstruction remains scoped
to the original5580 bill and retained compiler parameters.

Frame optimization in5575 and input/output basis work in5125 remain separate
constructive work; this package performs no physical contact or basis search.
The retained20:48:16UTC snapshot is historical and is not presented as a latest
family inventory or exhaustive novelty search.
